newsitem.title: BRAZIL: GM Brazil unit to sell cars to South Africa.
newsitem.headline: GM Brazil unit to sell cars to South Africa.

text.p: General Motors Corp's Brazilian unit plans to export in the next 12 months 25,000 small Corsa cars to South Africa, a company spokesman said.
General Motors do Brasil directors plan to travel to South Africa later this month to launch the Corsa car, he said.
"This is another step towards our plan to turn the Brazilian unit a world export base," the spokesman added.
The General Motors unit also expects to complete negotiations by the end of the year to export Corsa models to China and countries comprising the Andean Pact, he said.
The company will also begin exporting 60,000 sport utility Blazers to Russia in the next few months.
Export revenues at General Motors do Brasil are expected to reach $700 million this year and $1 billion in 1997, the spokesman said.
Revenues are projected to reach $8 billion in Brazil in 1996.
